question: How much was disbursed to Maternal & Child Health from 1 April through 30 June 2025 inclusive? Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, DD/MM/YYYY (day first), or D Mon YYYY. Use INR; L/lakh = 100,000, Cr = 10,000,000, k = 1,000, and treat blank, '-' and NA amounts as zero.
trap: Parsing 03/04/2025 as March 4 instead of 3 April.
